notes.title: Announcing Elemental War Clash
notes.content:
We are happy to announce a new game in our tower defense series: [b]Elemental War Clash[/b]!

It combines the best features of Elemental War 1 and 2 to create a new and better experience:

[list]
[*]Dozens of different towers with different abilities and strengths
[*]3 singleplayer modes: Hero Mode, Classic Mode, Survival Mode
[*]Plenty of passive and active items as well as tower equipment
[*]Monster abilities from Gold Rush to Invincibility to make each run unique
[*]Different and visual stunning environments from desert to ice world
[*]Different skills with multiple upgrades to customize your playing behavior
[*]Plenty of different monsters and elementals
[*]Several quests to unlock new items for Hero Mode
[*]Level editor to create and share new maps
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/3188970/

notes.title: Release of Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The second content update during the early access of HexaScape is live now 🥳.

With some delay due to other projects, personal stuff and more it’s finally time to launch the new update.

The biggest change we added is that you now can recharge your re-rolls which helps to keep control of what you can do during the game. You can recharge them either with a new event we added to the emitters or by connecting tiles. Every 50th tile connected to your core grants you a re-roll. And of course you see the progress as well.

Besides that there is another new event, a new score boost biome and several small improvements and fixes you probably never will notice, some also as preparation for the next updates and the console port.

[h2]Complete changelog[/h2]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added score boost biome
[*]added new Damage Buff event
[*]added new Add re-roll event
[*]re-rolls now charge every 50 tiles connected
[*]improved loading speed especially for huge maps
[*]added hint on what platform maps were created
[*]maps of blocked users aren’t displayed anymore
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed locked maps not getting properly visualized directly after game launch
[*]fixed performance with many viruses on the map
[/list]

Work on the next update as well the console port for the full release is already in progress. If you have ideas or feedback in general, feel free to chat with us on our Discord and let us know, what you think 😊

If you find any bugs, encounter any problems, or have any suggestions for great additions to the game, let us know in the forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Release of Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The first big content update during the early access of HexaScape is live now 🥳.

We added some new features to the game you can use in the editor as well as play on the three new campaign maps and the new endless mode. The features are a new victory condition to connect two regions directly, a trigger/receiver mechanic so when building to a defined spot you trigger some event on another tile/biome and the new tile limited mode. That mode doesn't contain viruses, but you will slowly run out of new tiles to place when you don't complete quests.

Besides that we have several fixes and quality of life improvements that should make playing in general easier, but also help to get started as we also improved the tutorials and some more tooltips and information.

We also changed the skillpoint mechanic. Instead of having to connect them to your towers you can freely place them now and you have a global skillpoint pool. This will make it a lot easier to spread skills among towers instead of specializing on just one of them.

[h2]Complete changelog[/h2]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added new trigger/receiver mechanic in the editor
[*]added victory condition to directly connect two regions
[*]added tile limited game mode
[*]added some more prompts to get additional information
[*]added proper icons to pipeline and data block tooltip
[*]improved virus spawner animation
[*]increased camera speed
[*]increased general game speed
[*]adjusted difficulty of spawner count extend path length quests
[*]improved side mission generation to respect current map to not show impossible missions anymore
[*]reworked skillpoint system to make it easier to unlock and use them
[*]improved efficiency mode for corrosion upgrade in combination with the Technology Push skill
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed controller navigation in editor settings menu
[*]fixed tooltips overlapping new mission pop up
[*]fixed game settings navigation not working properly
[*]fixed preview of next tile in tutorial 2 being wrong after spending first upgrade point
[*]fixed camera range not being properly restored when loading savegame
[*]fixed rare issue that caused empty quest display being visible when no quest is available anymore
[*]fixed hang when connecting a big cluster
[*]fixed upgrade/skill point marker not being displayed anymore for towers not having a quest
[*]fixed edge highlight not properly updating before first tile movement
[/list]

Now the work on the second update is running. If you have ideas or feedback in general, feel free to chat with us on our Discord and let us know, what you think 😊

If you find any bugs, encounter any problems, or have any suggestions for great additions to the game, let us know in the forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Map of the Week Contest
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your support so far! It is great that you like the idea of the game. That's incredibly important to know and gives us confidence for the next steps! We're already working on new game modes that we'll share with you soon 😊 But let's now start with the Map of the Week Contest!

[h2]Map of the Week[/h2]
In HexaScape: Cyber Defense, you can create your own maps and upload them for everyone. We want to put your creations in the spotlight, so like for the demo, we will select the weekly best map winner together with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/c9291a79d6b87b93ba780c7dadc0f1b4693d32d9.png[/img]

[h3]How to submit your map[/h3]
You can submit any map in our "[url=https://discordapp.com/channels/517398954430824459/1234444143002914826]hexascape-submit-your-map[/url]" Discord channel. All we need is the title of the map and the username of the creator (you can either nominate your own or other creators' maps).

Any map created between Monday and Sunday is eligible. Maps created after Sunday will be part of next week's contest. For the very first voting, we will even allow maps that were created last week.

[h3]Vote for the Map of the Week[/h3]
In the week after the submissions, all submitted maps will be presented in our Discord channel "[url=https://discordapp.com/channels/517398954430824459/1234444277720023040]hexascape-map-of-the-week[/url]". All users will have the opportunity to vote for their favorite. And the map with the most votes wins!

[h3]Stand in the spotlight for a week[/h3]
Eternal (one-week) fame for the Map of the Week! 🏆
[list]
[*] Your map will take the top spot in the Top Rated Maps category for one week
[*] The developers may play your map on stream
[*] Receive an entry into our Map of the Week [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/517398954430824459/1234445050709278730]Hall of Fame on our Discord server[/url]
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Follow us on Discord![/url]

[previewyoutube=MajT21aXqeU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: HexaScape is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We did it. We pushed the button. HexaScape is now in Early Access. Wow.

But that's not all. We want to make the game bigger and better with every update. And we want you to become part of the cyberspace, to follow our journey, to be our advisor. That's why we're offering a 10% discount on the release. The total price of the game will increase as we move towards full release, rewarding you explorers and discoverers for your early interest in the game.

[previewyoutube=MajT21aXqeU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We'll be [b]adding new features to HexaScape on a monthly basis[/b], some of them minor, many of them major. These are some of the bigger ideas we want to work on:
[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay Additions[/b]: Imagine connecting to a certain tile and it destroys a bug biome, allowing you to explore new parts of the map.
[*] [b]New Game Modes[/b]: Imagine a Tetris-like game mode where you have a limited time to place your tiles - otherwise they will be placed automatically (and not to your advantage...).
[*] [b]New Victory Conditions[/b]: Imagine escorting entities from your core to a target location and preventing them from coming into contact with viruses.
[*] [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Imagine a two player clash mode where you place the spawners for your opponents to make life REALLY uncomfortable for them.
[*] [b]New Maps[/b]: With each update, new maps will be released to showcase the new features of the game!
[/list]
New tiles, new environments, new controls in the editor... You get an idea of our wish list for HexaScape, don't you? But first and foremost, we want to hear your ideas on how to improve the game!

[h2]Take place in our streaming event[/h2]
We've also come up with a [b]streaming event[/b]! We are offering the following prizes for scores achieved in endless mode in livestreams (Twitch, YouTube) from June 20th, 10 a.m. to June 23rd, midnight (CEST):

[list]
[*]🏅 [b]Score over 15,000[/b]: Your name will be immortalized in-game as the name of a biome in the official campaign
[*]🥉 [b]Score over 25,000[/b]: 2 Steam keys for your chat, and your name will be immortalized in-game as the name of a biome in the official campaign
[*]🥈 [b]Score over 35,000[/b]: 5 Steam keys for your chat, and your name will be immortalized in-game as the name of a biome in the official campaign
[*]🥇 [b]Score over 45,000[/b]: 10 Steam keys for your chat, and your name will be immortalized in-game as the name of a biome in the official campaign
[/list]
To get your prize, just [url=mailto:contact@clockwork-origins.com]send us a link to the stream afterwards[/url]. ☺️

[h2]Famous last words[/h2]
If you like the game, please spread the word! As an indie developer, we're totally dependent on your word-of-mouth. If you find any bugs, encounter any problems, or have any suggestions for great additions to the game, let us know in the forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Discord[/url]. 💙

notes.title: Demo Update: All New & Freshly Painted!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

With the latest changes we have turned the whole demo upside down: There are 
[list]
[*] new tutorial maps (this also means that we had to reset all highscores), 
[*] many new sounds, 
[*] a revised mission system, 
[*] many helpers like markers for important locations and new tooltips,  
[*] the "Hexapedia" as a reference work for all gameplay questions and 
[*] many graphical revisions.
[/list]
We would like to introduce you to the most spectacular of the new graphics. It's the virus spawner, which we wanted to make look even more dangerous:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/f53da397107134cb305d60dc6b37de19ea19aac6.png[/img]
Now it should be clear that you can't expect anything good from this spawner, right? 😉

With this release, we've been able to realize all of our ideas, and now we need your feedback! What do you think of the new tutorial maps?

And we'd like to ask you a favor: [b]Please spread the word![/b] If you enjoy HexaScape, tell your friends, your grandparents and your pets about it. And of course we'd love to hear about it ourselves! 🙂

[h2]Map of the Week[/h2]
This week's Map of the Week is [b]Chaos 9[/b] by [i]silverstrife[/i]. The screenshot already gives you an idea of what you can expect in this map... Thanks for the submission and congratulations on the well-deserved award! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/c9291a79d6b87b93ba780c7dadc0f1b4693d32d9.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[b]The release![/b] You only have a few more days to wait: You'll be able to play the full version on June 20th.

notes.title: Demo Update: The final pieces to complete the puzzle
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We heard you! With the new demo update, we have added data lane end pieces to the game. These will help you complete your hex regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/aba86e67c57f690ec7cf5cf75fd358a22d50d067.png[/img]

What's more, you can now expand the scoreboard to show all entries:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/990618b4d4d5e7f5cd6aaa5c6a2197c0c647b612.png[/img]

However, my personal favorite of all the improvements is the NEW SOUNDTRACK by composer Sascha Schiemann (Elemental War 2, Tri6: Infinite, CyberTD). It's a blast! Be sure to put on your headphones while playing. 🎧

[h2]Map of the Week[/h2]
You've chosen your second Map of the Week, and the winner is [b]Challenge of the Gates[/b] by user [i]Locono1[/i]. And what a challenge it is! We didn't think something like this would be possible with the demo limits. Congratulations! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/a14b6db9327bab4919469fa22f22c6b7394eafa5.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
With the next big update we will add the final sounds and introduce Hexapedia, an in-game wiki with short explanations for every aspect of the game. After that, the demo will be feature complete in our eyes, so we can fully concentrate on the full version (to be released on June 20th, mark your calendars 📅).

notes.title: Demo Update: New Game Mechanic & Numerous Adjustments
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have uploaded an update to the HexaScape demo, but before we go into detail, we want to show you the first Map of the Week:

[h2]Map of the Week[/h2]
You voted your first Map of the Week, and the winner is [b]Chaos 3[/b] by user [i]silverstrife[/i]. Congratulations! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/003a9745ff5c8dadbbfd2bd706908787bf88e94c.png[/img]

Of course you can play this map (and every single one of the now 16 user maps) in the demo of HexaScape.

[h3]Demo Update[/h3]
HexaScape is a work in progress. Thanks to your feedback and some of our own ideas, the game is growing and hopefully becoming more interesting and accessible. 

First and foremost, we've added a re-roll feature (inspired by [i]Balatro[/i], you may have heard of it 😉) that allows you to re-roll the dice for the current tile. According to our first tests, this feature increases the thrill enormously...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982909/b2c2c9179f3f12036d71582ab99653476af187b2.png[/img]

Here's a quick summary of other improvements:
[list]
[*] We improved the performance a lot.
[*] We improved some of the graphics, especially the towers.
[*] We made the game more accessible, e.g. by turning on the display of the tower range by default and by weakening the bosses.
[*] We fixed some bugs.
[*] Map of the Week is now highlighted in the map overview.
[*] [Map Editor] You can now name each biome in your maps as you wish.
[/list]

[h3]New Early Access release date[/h3]
And there's more to come for both the demo and the upcoming Early Access release! Speaking of the Early Access release, we will be delaying the release by one month and will be entering Early Access on June 20th. But don't worry, new maps for the demo are released almost every day!

notes.title: There's More to Come... Outlook & Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Welcome to cyberspace ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109510/CyberTD/]again[/url])! With HexaScape we want to fulfill a childhood dream and create a game that reminds us of our favorite strategy board game, Carcassonne. It's all about building your own world with tiles - which is fascinating in itself - and at the same time defending it against evil influences (your parents, your friends, or computer viruses). Of course, HexaScape plays a little differently, but that's just because we love the tower defense genre so much that we can't make a game without TD mechanics.

[h2]Entering Early Access on May 23rd[/h2]
The development of HexaScape is not finished yet, and if we have our way, it won't be in the next few months. We have a lot of ideas about what mechanics to add to make the game more fun, but we think now is the time to show you the basic framework and let you decide what direction to take from here. That's why we'll be releasing a [b]polished and (for now) feature-complete version into Early Access on May 23rd[/b], just to be open for your thoughts and ideas afterwards to make everything even bigger and better.

[h2]Map of the Week[/h2]
If you'd like to join HexaScape on its journey through hostile cyberspace, you're welcome! Our demo gives you a taste of what's to come. Some of you have already tried out the map editor, and since we want to showcase your creations, we're going to start a weekly contest for the best new map. More information coming soon! Very soon, [b]we'll be streaming ourselves[/b], introducing you to our weird ideas. Don't miss it!

In the meantime, please give the demo a try, don't hate too much in the forums, and make sure that HexaScape gets a special place on your wish list. And please tell your parents, friends and fellow computer viruses!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647510/HexaScape_Cyber_Defense/
